metadata_findings: The only MetadataAssociation is SCIENCE ASSOCIATED to the record itself (GOME_MINDS_NO2 1.1): a self-relation, which should be removed or replaced with the lineage below.
The DATA SET LANDING PAGE (https://www.earthdata.nasa.gov/data/catalog/ges-disc-omps-npp-lp-l2-o3-daily-2.6) is the landing page of an unrelated dataset.
No ATBD in RelatedUrls and no PublicationReferences; the only document is the shared MINDS README, whose appendices give file formats for the OMI products only.
The Abstract is the MINDS project description in the future tense ("will develop ..."); it does not describe the GOME product, its input or its period.
Neither the record nor the README names the GOME Level 1B product or version used as input.
TemporalExtents and granules begin 1995-06-30; the README (Table 2) gives the GOME period as 04/1996–06/2003 and the Abstract as 1996-2003.
The README says "our current algorithm (v5) discussed in Lamsal et al (2021)", but that reference describes the OMI NO2 standard product version 4.0.
